acceptance_scope: Users can enter and explicitly review per-application wording for selected, approved responsibility facts. Source text/profile history remains unchanged; only selected responsibility facts can be rewritten. Exact date and numeric token multisets are preserved. Generation stores the original fact ID and source-text SHA-256 with the reviewed text in the immutable document context. Document validation reconstructs and checks that context; comparison shows the exact before/after wording from the historical profile snapshot.
acceptance_behavior: The connected UI requires explicit fact selection and a per-rewrite review checkbox; editing wording clears that attestation.
The application API rejects missing review, unselected facts, non-responsibility facts, stale profile snapshots, malformed/duplicate rewrites, and changes to source dates or numbers.
The durable PREPARE operation carries user-authored wording to the document worker; no AI/provider inference is used.
A new versioned template/model pair records user-reviewed factual paraphrases without reinterpreting historical documents.
TXT, DOCX and PDF are generated from the same validated paragraphs; the connected browser verifies the TXT download and format validation runs during generation.
Comparison verifies source hashes and historical inputs and exposes the exact original and rewritten responsibility wording after reload/profile edits.
The profile and cover letter remain unchanged by resume-only rewrites; a separate profile and cover-letter check passed.
Issue #96 remains OPEN/PARTIAL: this slice supports user-reviewed responsibility rewrites only; other factual summary/bullet rewriting and any AI rewrite behavior remain unaccepted.

limitations: The checkbox records user attestation; automated validation does not prove semantic equivalence of the user's rewritten sentence.
Exact date/numeric token preservation does not detect every possible unsupported non-numeric semantic change; the document remains explicitly user-reviewed.
Only responsibility-kind facts are eligible in this slice. Summary, project, accomplishment and other bullet-category rewrites are not implemented here.
Hosted Actions and independent review were not run under the local-only budget policy. Local checks do not imply hosted PASS.
